package curriculum

import (
	"context"
	"testing"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

const (
	plannerStudentID = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	plannerRequestID = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
)

type teacherEnsurerStub struct{ called bool }

func (stub *teacherEnsurerStub) Execute(context.Context, string) (domain.PersonalTeacher, error) {
	stub.called = true
	return domain.PersonalTeacher{StudentID: plannerStudentID}, nil
}

type learningPlannerStub struct {
	input  PlanInput
	result PlanResult
}

func (stub *learningPlannerStub) CreateCoursePlan(_ context.Context, input PlanInput) (PlanResult, error) {
	stub.input = input
	return stub.result, nil
}

func TestPlannerDelegatesTargetsAndConstraintsWithoutComputingPath(t *testing.T) {
	teachers := &teacherEnsurerStub{}
	plans := &learningPlannerStub{result: PlanResult{RequestID: plannerRequestID, GoalCode: "go.backend", Status: "PLANNING"}}
	planner := Planner{Teachers: teachers, Plans: plans}
	target := domain.LearningTargetRef{Type: domain.LearningTargetCapability, Key: "go.http.handler", Version: "v1"}
	result, err := planner.Execute(context.Background(), PlanInput{
		StudentID: plannerStudentID, IdempotencyKey: plannerRequestID,
		GoalCode: "GO.Backend", DesiredOutcome: "Build production Go APIs", Targets: []domain.LearningTargetRef{target},
		Constraints: PlanConstraints{WeeklyMinutes: 300},
		AuditRefs:   PlanAuditRefs{DialogID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"}, Reason: PlanReasonInitial,
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, teachers.called)
	require.Equal(t, plannerRequestID, result.RequestID)
	require.Equal(t, "go.backend", plans.input.GoalCode)
	require.Equal(t, []domain.LearningTargetRef{target}, plans.input.Targets)
	require.Equal(t, 300, plans.input.Constraints.WeeklyMinutes)
}

func TestPlannerRejectsMissingIdempotencyBeforeDelegation(t *testing.T) {
	plans := &learningPlannerStub{}
	_, err := (Planner{Teachers: &teacherEnsurerStub{}, Plans: plans}).Execute(context.Background(), PlanInput{
		StudentID: plannerStudentID, GoalCode: "go.backend", DesiredOutcome: "Learn Go", Reason: PlanReasonInitial,
	})
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrInvalidCurriculum)
	require.Empty(t, plans.input.StudentID)
}
